incremental.bootstrap_policy: INCREMENTAL first use requires explicit bounded from/to and an empty isolated target; source history is still read from the fixed 20100101 anchor so older active ST intervals can be materialized.
incremental.revision_overlap: Re-fetch 30 calendar days before verified-through, clipped to bootstrap anchor; intervals are re-expanded to each SSE open date.
incremental.checkpoint_policy: Only contiguous exact-definition, exact-target VERIFIED/VERIFIED_EMPTY INCREMENTAL runs with matching frozen SSE date lists and hash-verified annual raw-source receipts advance the checkpoint; BACKFILL does not.

source.route_policy: One non-paged natural-year request at a time from 20100101 through the frozen run end; fields ts_code,name,start_date,end_date; year responses are independently receipted and materialized into per-SSE-session positive ST rows.
source.python_rate_limit: table config 10/minute and connector decorator 10/minute; current shared Java endpoint cap still needs coordinator integration
source.cap_policy: A response at 5000 is persisted as incomplete raw evidence and rejected. Responses above the shared decoder bound fail closed; raw wire bytes are not available to this adapter. The provider's current official cap was not live-verified.
source.interval_policy: Uppercase name contains ST; start_date and nonempty end_date are inclusive; blank/null end_date remains active through frozen request end; overlapping periods deduplicate by full daily key.
source.evidence_policy: Annual raw rows and maps are deterministically ordered; each daily receipt references annual evidence by one safe relative filename, year, returned-row count, and SHA-256. Identical raw source content has identical fingerprints across run directories. Reopen confines annual references to the daily receipt evidence root, verifies every hash, and re-derives each per-date row. 512 MiB total run evidence bound.
source.row_count_scope: Four accepted source runs, including repeated business keys; cancellation/recovery separately evidenced; earlier rejected attempts retained.

write.row_count_scope: Logical source rows in four acceptance runs; no inferred insert/update split or total stage-copy write count.

checks.rate_limit: Actual source used configured endpoint 10/min and shared global budget; no natural provider throttling claimed
checks.retry: Shared bounded retry implementation; no new test suite or natural retry fault assertion
checks.pagination: Bounded non-paged source responses below cap; cap guard implemented, cap-hit live fault not claimed
checks.resume: CLI --resume-from only, exact frozen request, 280 verified page rows reused after stage reconstruction; stage creation can write rows
checks.cancel: Before-source zero rows and after-staged-page cancellation both durable CANCELLED
checks.unknown_write_reconcile: Two actual source rows sent; injected lost acknowledgement after sender close; bounded readback UNKNOWN_RECONCILED
checks.st_interval_retraction: incremental/backfill source windows are staged as preserved outside rows plus complete authoritative inside-window ST rows; revoked keys disappear through a D012 journaled rename publication, without synthetic is_st=0 rows; not live verified
checks.gradle_build: Java 24 scoped compilation and operational execution; no full Gradle build or new test-suite run claimed
checks.empty_day: VERIFIED_EMPTY with stale in-window row removed and outside snapshot unchanged
checks.source_revocation: Explicit synthetic obsolete key on owned target removed by complete real-source window replacement
checks.scoped_replacement: Real stage-to-target rename acknowledgement loss in nonempty and empty windows; IN_DOUBT -> verified, full readback, owned lease released
checks.live_tushare: Four source acceptance runs plus separately recorded recovery operations
